trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Treat it as the finish line of the roadmap: story first, then stranger strands, activities, collectibles, and finally 100% completion. Launch night it sat at 0.63% of tracked players, which mostly reflects reviewers and day-one players; expect it to take well over 100 hours.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, drifts and air time all count toward the total, and it accumulates across the whole game, so you do not need to grind it in one sitting. It is a long grind, not a hard one.

Illegal Operations are gang-run sites scattered around Leonida — hit one per gang, and the trophy counts gangs, not sites, so a second hit on the same gang adds nothing. Keep a note of which gangs you have done (the notes field here works for that) and work through all nine.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count up to 500, so this is a long accumulation trophy about the decisions you make across the game, for better or worse. trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, food, car mods, anything sold in a shop counts toward the total. It accumulates naturally as you gear up, so do not grind it early: play normally, buy what you need, and the total climbs. Late in the game, if you are short, a big purchase like a vehicle upgrade closes the gap. The counter tracks your spending.
